title: Yandruwandha people - Wikipedia
text: Yandruwandha people The Yandruwandha, alternatively known as Jandruwanta,[1] are an Aboriginal Australian people living in the Lakes area of South Australia, south of Cooper Creek and west of the Wangkumara people.
